description: Creates or updates an Active Directory Password Settings Object (PSO) and applies it to security groups or users. Supports create, update, and delete operations. Rollback removes newly created PSOs or restores previous settings.

pso_name.label: PSO Name
pso_name.description: Name of the Password Settings Object

precedence.label: Precedence
precedence.description: PSO precedence value (lower = higher priority; must be unique)

applies_to.label: Applies To
applies_to.description: List of group or user DNs to apply this PSO to

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Run preflight only — no PSO created or modified

rollback.description: For create: remove the PSO. For update: restore previous PSO settings from captured pre-change state. For delete: re-create PSO from captured state.

steps.description: Verify precedence is unique and target groups/users exist
Capture existing PSO state for rollback (update/delete operations)
Create, update, or delete the PSO
Apply PSO to specified groups and users
